name: Phoenix
body:
Aura strong conjuration (healing); CL 15th; Slot Back/Cloak; Price 32,500 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

This powerful tattoo is most often rendered with the large image of a phoenix, inked onto the back of the user.

One time per day when the wearer is brought below 0 hit points, he does not die, but instead, 1 round later, is fully healed (as heal.)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Tattoo, heal; Cost 16,250 gp.
